description: Land Title Settlement Department - Godakalana, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District  -  Cad. Map No.  510285
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 124, 125, and 52) with detailed information about land ownership, extent, encumbrances, and property rights. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land adjudication and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
